products.pre_existing_medical_conditions_summary: Claims arising from specified conditions within 2 years prior to policy issue or conditions needing specialist/hospital in last 12 months are excluded unless disclosed to and accepted by the insurer and shown on the policy schedule. products.non_traveller_health_rules: No cover under Sections A/B1/B2 for events related to a medical condition known before policy issue that affects a non‑travelling relative, non‑insured travelling companion, or a person you plan to stay with.

optional_activity_cover.notes: No medical expenses are covered while undertaking winter sports. Sections J1–J6 apply when purchased.

products.rental_vehicle_excess_conditions: Section H only reimburses the rental car excess charged under the rental agreement. No cover for vehicles excluded in Section H (e.g., commercial vehicles, trucks, motorbikes/mopeds, vehicles with <4 wheels). Must comply with rental agreement and be an authorised driver. Provide rental agreement, driver licence, inspection/incident reports, repair invoice, and rental company statement of excess liability.
products.luggage_conditions: Must take reasonable care; carry valuables in hand luggage; report loss/theft/damage within 72 hours and provide proof of ownership; unattended property exclusions apply; property in unattended motor vehicle only covered up to stated sub‑limit and with forced/violent entry; IMEI must be provided and blocked for phone/device claims.

Insurer may repair/replace/store credit/cash settle with depreciation applied. Contact claims on 02 9333 3965 or assistance@tickinsurance.com.au; claim forms available online.

source_evidence.quote:
Domestic Travel Insurance
Product Disclosure Statement
Effective: 01 April 2026
Europ Assistance Australia Pty Ltd (“Europ Assistance”), trading as Tick Travel Insurance. ABN: 71 140 219 594 ASFL Number 552106
Tick Domestic Travel Insurance provides cover for one trip within Australia up to a maximum duration that you select.
Level of Cover ... Tick Basic Tick Standard Tick Top

Cooling Off period ... within 14 days ... Cancelling your policy after the cooling off period ... refund ... proportion of the premium for the outstanding period of cover less any government charges and taxes that we cannot recover.

Eligibility a. This insurance is only available to travellers who are citizens or permanent residents of Australia or non‑permanent residents who have a valid Medicare, Private Health Fund or Overseas Student Travel Insurance in Australia. ... b. This insurance is only available to applicants who are 100 years of age or under at the date of applying ... c. This insurance is only available if you purchase your policy before you commence your trip.
The standard excess is $200 ... If you pay an extra premium, your policy can include an excess waiver (excess eliminator) which will remove all excesses (except for increased excesses listed ...).
Please note: This policy does NOT include cover for medical expenses incurred during your trip.

TABLE OF BENEFITS ... A Cancelling your trip before departure $1,500 ... C Travel delay expenses Nil ... D1 Personal belongings and baggage $2,000 ... Including: single article limit $500 ... Delayed baggage Nil ... Money Nil
F Personal liability $1,000,000 ... G Legal expenses Nil ... H Rental car excess waiver Nil ... I Covid‑19 Expenses: Cancellation or trip disruption Nil
Natural Disaster Cover ... Basic: A Yes, B1 No, B2 No
Please note: This Domestic Travel Insurance does not cover any travel on commercial cruise ships.
General Exclusion 6. Any claim relating to travel via a commercial cruise ship.
You must register any claim within 30 days after completion of your travel.

data._document_notes: The Table of Benefits formatting in the source appears compressed in the ingestion, requiring interpretation for Travel delay limits: interpreted as Standard up to $250 per completed 12 hours and Top up to $1,000 per completed 12 hours based on Section C wording and the table row. The policy defines Winter sports as including activities such as heli‑skiing in Section J definitions; however, the Table of excluded sports & activities later lists heli‑skiing as excluded. This inconsistency may be a drafting/placement error; extraction treats Winter sports as an optional add‑on with the listed J1–J6 benefits only (no medical cover), and relies on the ‘Table of covered winter sports’ for included activities. Minor cross‑references contain ‘Error! Bookmark not defined.’ artefacts in the Definitions section; these do not affect extracted limits.
